notes:
Versions

Vector: 1.12.15
WhiteStar: 0.5.2

What's Changed

  • Added support for Classics by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/388
  • Updated information on the vector about page by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/392
  • Added support for 4-player EMs by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/391
  • Player up reporting for EMs by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/402
  • added more configs for classics by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/404

Fixes

  • F14 Switch Matrix fix by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/399
  • system 11 game end dither clean up by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/398
  • Admin page load harden by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/403
  • classics ip display fix by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/406

Docs

  • classics board documentation by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/389
  • images for rottendog system11 installation instructions by @paulmullin in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/387

Development:

  • HIL: stop the post-flash reset race, bound every mpremote step, un-deprecate the runner by @mullinmax in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/390
  • Enable classic boards in HIL bench target resolution by @mullinmax with @Copilot in https://github.com/warped-pinball/vector/pull/393
